Step 1: 1012 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in the Gregorian calendar rules).  
Step 2: From 08-30, remaining days in 1012:  
Aug: 1 day (31-30) → Sep (30) + Oct (31) + Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 1+30+31+30+31 = 123 days.  
Step 3: 218 total − 123 = 95 days into 1013.  
Step 4: 1013 not leap (not divisible by 4). Jan 31, Feb 28 → 31+28=59, remaining 95−59=36 days into March. March 31 days → 36 days means April 5 (since March 31 + 5 days = April 5).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1013-04-05
